about: Self-hosted Data-Oriented contentmap span safety, sandbox confinement, key stability, caching, purity, error isolation, and cycle mutants.

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-spans-overlap-admitted
mutants.rule: VerifySpans requires generated intervals to be monotonically ordered and disjoint.

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-asset-escape-allowed
mutants.rule: Asset discovery rejects paths escaping the module root via parent traversal.

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-cache-key-includes-inline-line
mutants.to:
case content.InlineDerive as ind:
		("inline", ind.Package, strconv.Itoa(int(ind.Line)))
mutants.rule: Inline Line and Col are excluded from contentmap cache keys so line shifts preserve cache hits.

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-cache-hit-skipped
mutants.rule: Valid cached MappedErgo entries must be reused without re-invoking the mapper runner.

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-error-diag-still-parses
mutants.rule: Any Error MapperDiag stops before parsing MappedErgo.Source (one mistake, one diagnostic).

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-purity-allows-ffi
mutants.rule: Content mappers cannot call foreign import go packages at check time.

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-budget-output-unchecked
mutants.rule: CheckOutputBudget enforces MaxOutput on generated content mapper output.

mutants.name: selfhost-contentmap-cycle-not-reported
mutants.to: let _ = diagAtSpan(site, int(dense.Of((*pt).ExprPos, opid)), int(dense.Of((*pt).ExprEnd, opid)), msg)
mutants.rule: Mutual inline derive recursion must emit a content mapper cycle diagnostic.
